al-0xYV.title: Guardrail: double with extra-tall fence, flat
al-0xYV.summary: A highway in fairly flat land, divided by a double guardrail topped with an extra-tall fence.

al-2MxO.title: Houses: cylinder water tanks on roofs
al-2MxO.summary: Lots of cylinder-shaped water tanks sit on rooftops. Less common in Montenegro. Parts of Turkey have many similar tanks.

differs.how: Roof water tanks are less common there

al-3Ve1.title: Landscape: coastal-looking Aleppo pine forest
al-3Ve1.summary: A couple of small roads in the southwest run through very coastal-looking Aleppo pine forest.

al-83ib.title: Chevron: white on black
al-83ib.summary: White arrows on black chevrons. Italy, Greece and Spain use the same. Montenegro uses two different ones: black on white and red on yellow.

differs.how: Montenegro uses black on white or red on yellow

al-92gY.title: Language: letters Ë and Ç
al-92gY.summary: Albanian is not closely related to other European languages, so it looks distinct. Words often have the letter Ë and sometimes Ç. Kosovo uses it too.

al-A9yo.title: Landscape: big bay with peninsula and small island
al-A9yo.summary: A large bay with a long peninsula sticking out from the south and a small island just north of it, seen along a coastal road.

al-CS4O.title: Road lines: double outer lines with wide gap
al-CS4O.summary: On one stretch of road near the Greek border you may see double outer lines with a wide gap between them.

al-F6zP.title: Landscape: tall jagged bare mountains
al-F6zP.summary: On the road into a national park in the north, look for tall, jagged mountains with bare slopes.

al-F8jb.title: Landscape: valley with fully bare cliffs
al-F8jb.summary: A road in a valley with tall, completely bare cliff sides along it, near the eastern edge of the Montenegrin border.

al-FWHl.title: Guardrail: basic double guardrail through mountains
al-FWHl.summary: The only divided road with a plain double guardrail that goes directly through mountains. A mountain section of another highway has a fence above its guardrail or concrete blocks instead.

al-IKcR.title: Sign: speed limit with bold numbers
al-IKcR.summary: The numbers on speed limit signs are written in a bold font. Montenegro's are much thinner.

differs.how: Montenegrin speed signs use a much thinner font

al-LCAs.title: Cars: Mercedes sedans everywhere
al-LCAs.summary: Mercedes is by far the most popular car brand, and the sedan style shown is especially common.

al-LNw7.title: Median: plain concrete blocks
al-LNw7.summary: Two stretches of highway are divided by simple concrete blocks.

al-NGnJ.title: Houses: Italian-style, pastel
al-NGnJ.summary: Many Italian-style buildings: pastel colours, orange tiled roofs, and blocky shapes with lots of balconies.

al-NXsL.title: Pole: simple top with horizontal bars
al-NXsL.summary: Simpler poletops with horizontal bars. If you can't pick between Albania and Montenegro, guess Albania.

al-Ndso.title: Sign: backs of road signs painted black
al-Ndso.summary: The backs of road signs are often painted black. Italy and Romania do this too.

al-QA4i.title: Stop sign: S with short, angled ends
al-QA4i.summary: The S on stop signs has short ends at the same angle as the middle, instead of vertical ends. Direction signs sometimes have it too. Italian stop and direction signs share this.

al-QFIu.title: Landscape: wide, nearly dry river valley
al-QFIu.summary: A wide, almost dried-out river valley running southeast to northwest, seen along one road in the south.

al-TwNX.title: Landscape: town on west side of a wide valley
al-TwNX.summary: A town built on the western hillside of a wide valley.

al-Utnq.title: Sign: street word "rruga"
al-Utnq.summary: The Albanian word for street is rruga.

al-Ver8.title: Roadside: lots of exposed red soil
al-Ver8.summary: Plenty of bare red soil beside the road. Less common in Montenegro. Greece has similar soil, especially near the Albanian border.

differs.how: Red roadside soil is less common there

al-Wxzu.title: Landscape: old castle on a tall hill
al-Wxzu.summary: A town you can often recognise by an old castle at the top of a tall hill.

al-dFse.title: Google car: long antenna with rifts
al-dFse.summary: Gen 3 has two car versions. One has a long antenna and shows rifts in the sky. The other has a short antenna and no rifts.

al-i4Ky.title: Google car: low Gen 4 with big round blur
al-i4Ky.summary: A Gen 4 camera mounted lower than usual, with a fairly big round blur and a small bump at the front. The blur can be see-through and hard to spot. Much of the Balkans and southern Europe has it.

al-iM5P.title: Google car: sky rifts from poor stitching
al-iM5P.summary: Rarely, Gen 3 coverage shows odd breaks in the sky where the images were badly stitched together. Montenegro has them just as often.

al-imi2.title: Landscape: green mountains
al-imi2.summary: Mostly mountainous with a Mediterranean climate and plants. Flat farming valleys sit between the hills. Mountains are usually green with patches of bare rock.

al-kR9B.title: Guardrail: basic double guardrail, flat land
al-kR9B.summary: A divided road with a plain double guardrail, running through flat land with no mountains.

al-lm-740896.title: Landscape: big mountain range to the east
al-lm-740896.summary: The capital has a large mountain range to its east. Combined with Gen 3 coverage and plates with blue strips on both sides, it is a sure sign.

al-nISa.title: Guardrail: flat wide ends bending away
al-nISa.summary: Flat, wide guardrail ends that bend away from the road are common. Italy has the same ends.

al-nK4e.title: Plate: red strip on left, or blue both sides
al-nK4e.summary: Plates have either a single red strip on the left or blue strips on both sides. Red on the left is unique in Europe. Italian plates also have blue on both sides, but the front plates are clearly shorter.

differs.how: Italian front plates are distinctly shorter

al-oT18.title: Median: concrete blocks with grass between
al-oT18.summary: Some highways around the big cities and south of the capital are divided by concrete blocks with grass and greenery between them.

al-sQLY.title: Landscape: massive mountain with sheer cliff top
al-sQLY.summary: In the south, a huge mountain with an almost vertical cliff near the top, visible from several nearby roads.

al-uBm9.title: Guardrail: triple guardrail on a divided highway
al-uBm9.summary: Few divided highways are covered. The easiest to recognise is one section of the A1 highway, the only one divided by a triple guardrail.

al-vH1O.title: Pole: upside-down triangle top
al-vH1O.summary: Poletop shaped like an upside-down triangle. Serbia, Czechia, Slovakia and Romania use similar tops, so check other clues.

al-yEQq.title: Landscape: very mountainous, flat in the west
al-yEQq.summary: Very mountainous. Flat farmland and low hills are mostly in the west, and a flat highland plateau sits in the southeast. The highest, sometimes almost alpine, mountains are in the far north and far south.

al-z0A7.title: Bollard: black top, red reflector
al-z0A7.summary: White post with a black top and a red-and-grey reflector. Same as Italy, so it narrows it to Albania or Italy.
